yaml:
apiVersion: build.openshift.io/v1
kind: BuildConfig
metadata:
  name: app-build
spec:
  runPolicy: Serial
  source:
    type: Git
    git:
      uri: https://github.com/example/app.git
      ref: main
  strategy:
    type: Source
    sourceStrategy:
      from:
        kind: ImageStreamTag
        name: nodejs:20-ubi9
        namespace: openshift
  output:
    to:
      kind: ImageStreamTag
      name: app:latest
  triggers:
    - type: ConfigChange
    - type: ImageChange
      imageChange: {}
